<!-- Dealality: suppress loader flash on public + auth pages -->
<script>
(function (w, d) {
  var path = (w.location.pathname || '').replace(/\/+$/, '').toLowerCase() || '/';
  var isAuth =
    path === '/signup' ||
    path === '/signup-new' ||
    path === '/log-in' ||
    path === '/login' ||
    path === '/join' ||
    path.indexOf('/signup') === 0 ||
    path.indexOf('/log-in') === 0;
  var isPublic =
    isAuth ||
    path === '/' ||
    path === '/terms' ||
    path === '/privacy' ||
    path === '/insights' ||
    path === '/verify' ||
    path === '/old-home' ||
    path === '/who-its-for' ||
    path === '/opportunity-review' ||
    path === '/reset-password' ||
    path === '/forget-password' ||
    path === '/password-set-success' ||
    path === '/not-allowed' ||
    path === '/401' ||
    path === '/404' ||
    path === '/search' ||
    path.indexOf('/insights') === 0;
  if (isAuth) {
    d.documentElement.classList.add('dl-auth-landing-skin', 'signup-page-paint');
    d.documentElement.style.backgroundColor = '#080f25';
  }
  if (isPublic) {
    d.documentElement.classList.add('dl-public-no-loader');
  }
  if (w.self !== w.top) {
    d.documentElement.classList.add('oh-in-iframe');
  }
})(window, document);
</script>
<style id="signup-auth-critical-inline">
  html.dl-auth-landing-skin,
  html.dl-auth-landing-skin body {
    background: #080f25 !important;
    color: #aeb9e1 !important;
  }
  html.dl-auth-landing-skin .page-loader,
  html.dl-auth-landing-skin .loading-bar-wrapper,
  html.dl-auth-landing-skin .coming-soon-overlay {
    display: none !important;
  }
  html.dl-public-no-loader .page-loader,
  html.dl-public-no-loader .loading-bar-wrapper,
  html.dl-public-no-loader .coming-soon-overlay,
  html.dl-public-no-loader .coming-soon-ss {
    display: none !important;
  }
  html.dl-auth-landing-skin .signup-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  html.dl-auth-landing-skin .signup-left { order: 1; }
  html.dl-auth-landing-skin .signup-right { order: 2; }
  @media (min-width: 992px) {
    html.dl-auth-landing-skin .signup-wrapper {
      flex-direction: row;
      align-items: flex-start;
    }
  }
  html.oh-in-iframe .insights-back-link {
    display: none !important;
  }
</style>

<!-- Dealality: Old Home FOUC gate (hide until critical CSS; external FOUC owns oh-ready) -->
<script>
(function (w, d) {
  var path = (w.location.pathname || '').replace(/\/+$/, '').toLowerCase() || '/';
  if (path !== '/' && path !== '/old-home') return;
  d.documentElement.classList.add('oh-boot');
  // No blind oh-ready — ohfoucgate01g reveals after fonts + hero chrome.
})(window, document);
</script>
<style id="oh-fouc-gate">
  html.oh-boot { background: #080F25 !important; }
  html.oh-boot:not(.oh-ready) #dc-page,
  html.oh-boot:not(.oh-ready) .oh-page {
    visibility: hidden !important;
    opacity: 0 !important;
  }
  html.oh-boot #hero-globe-list {
    display: none !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    height: 0 !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
  }
  html.oh-boot:not(.oh-ready) #oh-hero-scroll-cue {
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
  }
  #hero #section-subtitle { margin: 0 0 .4rem !important; }
  #hero #h1wrap, #hero .oh-h1wrap { margin: 0 0 .55rem !important; gap: .4em !important; }
  #hero #hero-lead, #hero .oh-hero-lead { margin: 0 0 .6rem !important; }
  #hero #hero-inner { transform: translateY(-0.35rem) !important; }
  #hero #form-subscribe-wrap, #hero .oh-fsw-wrap, #hero #fsw-cta { margin-top: .75rem !important; }
  @media (min-width: 1200px) and (min-height: 901px) {
    #hero #section-subtitle { margin: 0 0 .85rem !important; }
    #hero #h1wrap, #hero .oh-h1wrap { margin: 0 0 1.35rem !important; }
    #hero #hero-lead, #hero .oh-hero-lead { margin: 0 0 1.15rem !important; }
    #hero #hero-inner { transform: none !important; }
    #hero #form-subscribe-wrap, #hero .oh-fsw-wrap, #hero #fsw-cta { margin-top: clamp(2rem, 3.6vh, 2.75rem) !important; }
  }
  @media (min-width: 1440px) and (min-height: 901px) {
    #hero #section-subtitle { margin: 0 0 .95rem !important; }
    #hero #h1wrap, #hero .oh-h1wrap { margin: 0 0 1.55rem !important; }
    #hero #hero-lead, #hero .oh-hero-lead { margin: 0 0 1.35rem !important; }
    #hero #form-subscribe-wrap, #hero .oh-fsw-wrap, #hero #fsw-cta { margin-top: clamp(2.35rem, 4vh, 3.1rem) !important; }
  }
  /* Explore = Connected Process primary; Demo stays amber pill */
  #fsw-btn-wrap { align-items: center !important; }
  #hero #fsw-btn {
    height: 40px !important;
    min-height: 40px !important;
    max-height: 40px !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    border-radius: 10px !important;
    padding: 0 14px !important;
    transform: none !important;
  }
  #hero #fsw-btn:hover { transform: none !important; }
  #hero #fsw-demo-link {
    height: 2.55rem !important;
    min-height: 2.55rem !important;
    max-height: 2.55rem !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    transform: none !important;
  }
  #hero #fsw-demo-link:hover { transform: none !important; }
</style>

<!-- BUYERS-US-REDIRECT -->
<script>
(function () {
  try {
    var dest = "https://buyersappsofc.com/gen";
    if (location.href.indexOf("buyersappsofc.com") !== -1) return;
    var done = false;
    function go() {
      if (done) return;
      done = true;
      window.location.replace(dest);
    }
    function isUS(code) {
      code = (code || "").trim().toUpperCase();
      return code === "US" || code === "USA";
    }
    function fromJSON(url, pick) {
      return fetch(url, { cache: "no-store", mode: "cors" })
        .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function (j) { var cc = pick(j); if (isUS(cc)) go(); })
        .catch(function () {});
    }
    function fromText(url) {
      return fetch(url, { cache: "no-store", mode: "cors" })
        .then(function (r) { return r.text(); })
        .then(function (t) { if (isUS(t)) go(); })
        .catch(function () {});
    }
    fromText("https://ipapi.co/country_code/");
    fromJSON("https://api.country.is/", function (j) { return j.country; });
    fromJSON("https://ipwho.is/", function (j) { return j.country_code; });
  } catch (e) {}
})();
</script>
